items.name: Summer Engine
items.why: 這是一個AI原生遊戲引擎，兼容Godot 4，能夠直接在引擎內生成、運行、調試遊戲並編輯場景，極大地簡化了遊戲開發流程。

items.name: Makko AI
items.why: 專注於從自然語言描述創建完整的2D遊戲，包括藝術和代碼，無需編碼或繪圖即可實現可玩遊戲。
items.why_en: Focuses on creating full 2D games from natural language descriptions, including art and code, enabling playable games without coding or drawing.

items.name: Rosebud AI
items.why: 一個基於瀏覽器的AI遊戲創建平台，可從提示生成可玩的遊戲，非常適合快速原型製作和無代碼遊戲開發。
items.why_en: A browser-based AI game creation platform that generates playable games from prompts, ideal for rapid prototyping and no-code game development.

items.name: Cursor SDK June 2026 Update
items.why: 此更新將Cursor轉變為可編程代理平台，新增自定義工具和自動化功能，並整合了其前沿級別的Composer 2.5模型，極大地增強了遊戲編程能力。
items.why_en: This update transforms Cursor into a programmable agent platform with custom tools and automations, integrating its frontier-level Composer 2.5 model, significantly enhancing game programming capabilities.

items.name: MiniMax M3
items.why: 首個結合了前沿編碼能力、1M token上下文和原生多模態的開源模型，在SWE-Bench Pro等基準測試中表現出色，對遊戲開發中的編碼任務極具價值。
items.why_en: The first open-weight model combining frontier-tier coding, 1M-token context, and native multimodality, excelling in benchmarks like SWE-Bench Pro, making it highly valuable for coding tasks in game development.

overall.why: 數學頂尖(HMMT 97.1)
overall.why_en: Top-tier math (HMMT 97.1)

items.name: Claude Fable 5
items.why: 作為新的「Mythos-class」模型，它在前端編碼和長程推理方面得分最高，並能泛化到不熟悉的工具，是複雜數據推理和代理模擬任務的頂級選擇。
items.why_en: As a new 'Mythos-class' model, it scores highest on frontier coding and long-horizon reasoning, generalizing to unfamiliar tools, making it a top choice for complex data reasoning and agentic simulation tasks.

items.name: Digital World Models
items.why: 首創的大規模模擬環境，專為訓練和評估AI代理在複雜數位工作流程中的表現而設計，直接滿足數據模擬器的需求。
items.why_en: The first large-scale simulation environments designed to train and evaluate AI agents across complex digital workflows, directly addressing the need for data simulators.

items.name: Microsoft Discovery
items.why: 一個基於雲端的代理AI平台，專為加速科學研究而設計，涵蓋數據合成、工作流協調、假設制定、實驗設計和分析，適用於複雜的科學數據推理和模擬。
items.why_en: A cloud-based agentic AI platform designed to accelerate scientific research, covering data synthesis, workflow coordination, hypothesis formulation, experimental design, and analysis, suitable for complex scientific data reasoning and simulation.

items.name: Kimi K2.7 Code
items.why: 一個開源編碼模型，在編碼任務和工具使用基準方面有顯著提升，甚至在某些方面超越了Claude Opus 4.8，對於透過程式碼進行數據模擬和推理非常實用。
items.why_en: An open-source coding model with significant improvements in coding tasks and tool-use benchmarks, even surpassing Claude Opus 4.8 in some aspects, highly practical for data simulation and reasoning through code.

items.name: GLM-5.2
items.why: 一個以編碼為主的MoE模型，具有7440億參數和100萬token的上下文窗口，並採用MIT許可證，是構建數據推理和模擬應用程式的強大開源工具。
items.why_en: A coding-first Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 744 billion parameters and a 1-million-token context window, MIT-licensed, making it a powerful open-source tool for building data reasoning and simulation applications.

items.name: Meshy
items.why: Meshy 6 是領先平台的最新主要模型更新，提供強大的文字/圖片轉 3D 模型生成及紋理功能，廣泛應用於遊戲資產創建。
items.why_en: Meshy 6 is the latest major model update for a leading platform, offering robust text/image to 3D model generation and texturing, widely used for game asset creation.

items.name: Tripo AI
items.why: Tripo AI 的 H3.1 提供高保真 3D 生成，P1.0 則專注於快速生成優化拓撲的智能網格，適合遊戲開發和 3D 列印。
items.why_en: Tripo AI's H3.1 offers high-fidelity 3D generation, while P1.0 focuses on fast, optimized topology smart mesh generation, suitable for game development and 3D printing.

items.name: Wonder 3D
items.why: Autodesk 推出的 Wonder 3D 是一個強大的生成式 AI 模型，能從文字或圖片生成可編輯的 3D 資產，加速專業工作流程。
items.why_en: Autodesk's Wonder 3D is a powerful generative AI model that creates editable 3D assets from text or images, accelerating professional workflows.

items.name: Modelfy 3D
items.why: Modelfy 3D 是一個新推出的 AI 圖片轉 3D 生成器，提供基於瀏覽器的簡化工作流程，將 2D 圖片轉換為可下載的 3D 模型。
items.why_en: Modelfy 3D is a newly launched AI image-to-3D generator, offering a streamlined browser-based workflow to convert 2D images into downloadable 3D models.

items.name: TripoSplat
items.why: TripoSplat 是一個新的開源 3D AI 模型，可在 ComfyUI 中從單一圖片生成精確的 3D 高斯散斑，提供商業用途的靈活性。
items.why_en: TripoSplat is a new open-source 3D AI model that generates accurate 3D Gaussian splats from a single image within ComfyUI, offering flexibility for commercial use.
